requirements.text: Allow students to personalise their timetables with a colour picker for modules, a toggle option to hide cancelled classes, and the ability to add their own study blocks.
Automate notifications for students when grades are posted, ideally within five minutes of posting, through their preferred channels (email, SMS, in-app messages).
Send automated reminders for assignment deadlines and exam dates at strategic intervals, with options for students to customize their notification preferences.

Implement a structured module feedback system that includes a mix of rating scales and open-ended questions about content quality, delivery, and resources, ensuring anonymity and timely access to feedback.
Ensure that all enhancements integrate seamlessly with the existing portal authentication system without altering the current student login process.
The existing student records database schema must not be modified, requiring creative implementation of new features.
Ensure that feedback collected from students remains anonymous to protect their identity and is only accessible to module coordinators after grades have been submitted.
All enhancements must comply with GDPR regulations and the university's data retention policies to protect student privacy.
Grade notifications must be delivered quickly, ideally within five minutes of posting.
Module feedback should only be accessible to coordinators after grades have been submitted to avoid any bias.
